Oindrilla is a Data Scientist at Red Hat, the world's leading provider of Enterprise ready open-source solutions. She is working in the Office of the CTO working on emerging trends and research in ML and AI.

Her work has been focused on developing Natural Language Processing tools for core business operations, development and productization processes. She has a Masters Degree in Computer Science with a specialization in Data-centric computing from Boston University.
